name: Execution Environment
owner: Isolated workers, compute, sandboxing, resource limits, filesystem/network constraints, teardown, resumption infrastructure
boundary: Accepts an authorised workload envelope from L; returns execution result and measured usage
proof_required: Workload attestation, quota/termination log, isolation test
overlap_guard: Control plane must authorise policy; layer executes declared responsibility
ownership_test: E performs isolated compute; no permission minting
conflict_boundary: Tenant boundaries; compute and egress resource ceilings

name: Tooling
owner: Tool catalogue, schema binding, protocol adapters, idempotency contract, invocation adapter and result normalisation
boundary: Receives a tool intent from L and an authorisation decision from Gateway; calls only registered tools
proof_required: Tool-schema version, request/response receipt, side-effect receipt
overlap_guard: Control plane must authorise policy; layer executes declared responsibility
ownership_test: T uses registered versioned adapters after admission
conflict_boundary: Tool schema drift and direct external bypass

name: Context
owner: Intake normalisation, ACL-filtered retrieval implementation, context assembly, canonical entity IDs, semantic reconciliation, working/episodic/semantic memory, provenance
boundary: Reads or writes context under Identity and Data Protection policy; passes provenance-bearing context to L
proof_required: Context manifest, source lineage, reconciliation and memory-write ledger
overlap_guard: Control plane must authorise policy; layer executes declared responsibility
ownership_test: C retrieves, reconciles and carries provenance
conflict_boundary: Cannot override source ACL or authoritative policy

name: Lifecycle
owner: Harness, event loop, plan/step budget, agent and persona lifecycle, checkpoints, multi-agent coordination, escalation, interruption and resume
boundary: Invokes E/T/C; cannot create authorisation; supplies execution intent and delegation references to the control-plane enforcement points
proof_required: Trajectory, step budget report, checkpoint transitions, completion record
overlap_guard: Control plane must authorise policy; layer executes declared responsibility

name: Identity
owner: Human, agent, tenant and delegated identities; claims issuance and attenuation
boundary: Application business approval or gateway transport
proof_required: Issued actor-chain token; entitlement decision inputs; expiry/revocation
overlap_guard: Does not own: Application business approval or gateway transport
conflict_boundary: Not business approval or Gateway PEP

name: Gateway
owner: Admission, model/tool/agent routing policy, protocol termination, egress and mandatory side-effect enforcement
boundary: Credential issuance, enterprise policy authorship, tool business logic
proof_required: Tool/model/A2A policy enforcement point; decision receipt; deny-path test
overlap_guard: Does not own: Credential issuance, enterprise policy authorship, tool business logic
conflict_boundary: Do not assume central proxy physically intercepts every context read

name: Observability
owner: Collection and correlation of telemetry; trajectories, metrics and incident signals
proof_required: Correlated event stream, SLO report, retention-class metadata
overlap_guard: Does not own: Release-quality verdict, policy decision
conflict_boundary: Telemetry ≠ test pass or policy permit

name: Verification
owner: Behavioural assertions, evaluations, integrity checks, release and runtime verification gates
boundary: Business risk appetite, audit retention policy
proof_required: Assertion report, evidence grade and signed release-gate result
overlap_guard: Does not own: Business risk appetite, audit retention policy
conflict_boundary: Gateway blocked action ≠ agent behaved acceptably

name: Governance
owner: Autonomy classes, accepted risk, exception and approval authority, ownership, review and change policy
boundary: Inline routing, token minting, evaluator implementation
proof_required: Policy bundle, approval record, waiver/expiry, attestation
overlap_guard: Does not own: Inline routing, token minting, evaluator implementation
conflict_boundary: Does not author tool execution or issue tokens

name: FinOps
owner: Cost allocation rules, budgets, unit economics, pricing assumptions and financial exceptions
boundary: Gateway execution of routing or resource metering
proof_required: Budget decision, cost ledger and forecast/reconciliation
overlap_guard: Does not own: Gateway execution of routing or resource metering
conflict_boundary: Does not meter resources or enforce network routes

name: Data Protection
owner: Data classification, consent handling, residency, retention, deletion and encryption rules
proof_required: Classification decision, access/write/delete proofs, residency verification
overlap_guard: Does not own: Identity issuance, semantic conflict resolution
conflict_boundary: Does not resolve business semantic identity

name: Interoperability
owner: Protocol selection, version contract, compatibility and event semantics across boundaries
boundary: Gateway network proxy operation, Context's business entity resolution
proof_required: Versioned protocol registry, conformance report, mapping record
overlap_guard: Does not own: Gateway network proxy operation, Context's business entity resolution
conflict_boundary: No business entity mastership or proxy runtime ownership
